# `sentences`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
sentences(str[, lang[, country]])
```

Splits `str` into an array of array of words.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not in the function registry yet |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT sentences('Hi there! Good morning.');
```

Result:

```text
[["Hi","there"],["Good","morning"]]
```

```sql
SELECT sentences('Hi there! Good morning.', 'en');
```

Result:

```text
[["Hi","there"],["Good","morning"]]
```

```sql
SELECT sentences('Hi there! Good morning.', 'en', 'US');
```

Result:

```text
[["Hi","there"],["Good","morning"]]
```
